#r
#case
Another walk and another taste of reality…
Prostitution on the streets. Even on the main street some skimpily dressed women tend to wave at passersby. Only a fool wouldn’t know what they are about.
Screams coming out of a back-alley… {{wi}}It’s better to just ignore. {{wi}}Like everyone else…
Walks like this just gut me in every sense of the word…
#end
#case
Today's walk gave me an eerie reminder of where I live.
A group of hobos were crowding around a… 
I don’t even want to think about what it was. The stench was unbearable.
I might puke…
#end
#case
This city is getting worse.
During my walk I saw an armed robbery taking place. 
He really was threatening them with a gun…
What the hell…
#end
#case
I think this city is getting worse and worse.
A family in shoddy clothes was sleeping on a bus stop. 
They looked… homeless.
A few meters further a business man was being seduced by a diseased looking prostitute.
A group of thugs passed nearby pointing their guns at random people…
What the hell is going on with this city…
Why is nobody doing anything about this…
#end
